QuestInfo.name: [Presidential Election] Speaking Hall Preparation 4 (Cole)
QuestInfo.0: The Republicans need more promotional materials. What could they be?
QuestInfo.1: Cole needs t-shirts to advertise their cause, and the Barnard Grays seem to be fond of wearing them. Bring Blank T-Shirts so he can do some printing and get them back to the Grays.
QuestInfo.2: You got 50 t-shirts! Return to Cole.

0.0: The Barnard Grays really LOVE t-shirts... and that got me thinking. That means they should be wearing OUR t-shirts! I want you to go 'liberate' their shirts, let me print on them, and then I'll take them back! They're going to love it.

yes.0: There are going to be a lot of good looking aliens pretty soon!

no.0: But... but... I made the design myself!

1.0: That looks like a lovely pile of t-shirts!

yes.0: You're a real red-blooded little helper! Keep this up, and I'll give you something great!

stop.0: Have some sense of duty! And fashion!
